constraints.reasoning: Section 3 carves out exceptions; propositional abstraction approximates this as overriding the general duty (information-scoping is collapsed).

constraints.translation: If BROOKS is legally compelled to disclose, BROOKS shall immediately notify CLIENT in writing.
If BROOKS immediately notifies CLIENT in writing, then (the clause that) BROOKS shall immediately notify holds.
If BROOKS is legally compelled, BROOKS will use best efforts (at CLIENT’s expense) to obtain/assist in obtaining a protective order.
constraints.reasoning: Explicitly tied to the compelled disclosure scenario.

constraints.translation: If BROOKS uses best efforts, then it will use best efforts (modal-removed relation).
CLIENT may seek a protective order/remedy and/or waive compliance.
If CLIENT seeks a protective order or waives compliance, then CLIENT may do so.
If BROOKS is compelled and there is no protective order and no waiver, BROOKS may disclose only the compelled portion without liability.
constraints.evidence: Section 4: "Failing the entry of a protective order ... or waiver ... BROOKS may disclose ... that portion (and only that portion)"
constraints.reasoning: Direct conditional permission stated in Section 4.

constraints.translation: If BROOKS discloses the compelled portion without liability, then it may disclose it (modal-removed relation).
If BROOKS may disclose the compelled portion without liability, then BROOKS has counsel advice about what is legally compelled.
constraints.evidence: Section 4: "that portion ... that BROOKS has been advised by written opinion counsel..."
constraints.reasoning: Text conditions the permissible disclosure on counsel advice; modeled as a strong implication.

constraints.translation: If BROOKS is legally compelled, BROOKS agrees to use best efforts to obtain assurance of confidential treatment by recipients.
constraints.evidence: Section 4: "provided, however, that BROOKS agrees to use its best efforts ... that confidential treatment will be accorded"
constraints.reasoning: Explicit undertaking within the compelled disclosure section.

constraints.translation: Upon termination and written request, BROOKS shall deliver the furnished materials and copies.
If BROOKS delivers the materials upon termination/request, then BROOKS shall deliver them (modal-removed relation).
If the relationship is terminated and CLIENT does not request return, BROOKS will retain the material for three years.
If BROOKS retains the material for three years, then it will retain it for three years (modal-removed relation).
If BROOKS retains the material for three years and desires to dispose, then it will dispose after ten days written notice.
constraints.evidence: Section 5: "free to dispose ... if it so desires and will do so after ten (10) days written notice"
constraints.reasoning: Text ties disposal (when desired) to a 10-day notice; retention-for-3-years is the context for the disposal freedom.

constraints.translation: If BROOKS disposes after ten days written notice, then it will dispose after ten days written notice (modal-removed relation).
The Agreement shall be governed by New York law.
If the Agreement is governed by New York law, then it shall be governed by New York law (modal-removed relation).
If New York law governs, then California law and Delaware law do not govern.
constraints.reasoning: Mutual exclusivity of governing-law selections in standard contracts.

constraints.translation: The Agreement shall remain in effect until one year after termination (part of the "earliest of" rule).
If it remains in effect until one year after termination, then it shall remain so (modal-removed relation).

If an alternate termination date exists, the agreement still remains in effect at least until an earliest-of condition is met (captured by including the one-year clause as part of the earliest-of set).
constraints.reasoning: Zeroth-order approximation: the contract defines the term as the earliest of two candidates; precise "earliest" ordering cannot be represented directly here.

constraints.translation: Section headings are for convenience only.
Headings shall not be part of the agreement.
If headings are not part of the agreement, then headings shall not be part of the agreement (modal-removed relation).
Headings shall not affect meaning/interpretation.
If headings do not affect meaning/interpretation, then headings shall not affect meaning/interpretation (modal-removed relation).
The Agreement is the entire understanding of the Parties as to the subject matter.
The Agreement supersedes all prior agreements/communications regarding the subject matter.
No later agreement affects obligations unless this Agreement and affected sections are cited in writing.
constraints.reasoning: Explicit conditional limitation on subsequent agreements.

constraints.translation: If a subsequent agreement affects obligations, then this Agreement and affected sections are explicitly cited in writing.
constraints.evidence: Section 9: "No subsequent agreements ... affect ... unless ... explicitly cited in writing"
constraints.reasoning: Direct logical reading of the "unless" condition.

constraints.translation: If this Agreement and affected sections are not cited in writing, then a subsequent agreement does not affect the obligations herein.
constraints.reasoning: Contrapositive-style constraint reflecting the clause intent.

constraints.translation: The Agreement cannot be amended except via a written, executed document referencing Section 10.
If the Agreement is amended/modified/supplemented, then there is a written, executed document referencing Section 10.
constraints.evidence: Section 10: "except by a written document ... executed ... explicitly references this Section 10"
constraints.reasoning: Direct necessity condition for valid amendment.

constraints.translation: If there is no qualifying written document referencing Section 10, then the Agreement is not amended/modified/supplemented (validly).
constraints.reasoning: Intended legal effect: amendments outside the specified mechanism are not permitted; modeled as a strong constraint.

constraints.translation: Notices must be in writing.
If notices are furnished in writing, then notices shall be furnished in writing (modal-removed relation).
Notices are delivered either by hand delivery, overnight courier, or certified/registered U.S. mail.
constraints.reasoning: The text lists permitted delivery methods; modeled as a disjunction of method propositions.

constraints.translation: If notices must be furnished in writing under the Agreement, they are delivered to the intended recipient at the last known business address.
constraints.evidence: Section 11: "to the intended recipient at such party’s last known business address"
constraints.reasoning: The clause pairs the notice requirement with the delivery-address rule; modeled as a strong associated constraint.

constraints.translation: The Parties have signed the Agreement.
